item.description:
Hi HN,

I don't want to run node.js on my Mac directly anymore, so I've built MyBox. Maybe you find it useful too:

MyBox is built on a fork of apple/container.

* Each box has its own Linux kernel.

* No mounts: Project files get copied.

* Packet filtering: No access to Mac and local network.

* Dedicated user: Apps cannot reach into the box.

* Touch ID/password: To open a shell or copy files.
